run.description: Run as the pane's own process, with no shell underneath.

size.description: Percentage of the split pane given to the new one (1-99).

type.description: Split direction. Omit on the first entry to use the window's initial pane.

wait_for.description: Delay command or run until ready: tcp:HOST:PORT, file:PATH, or an http(s) URL.

wait_timeout.description: Give up waiting after this long (default 2m).

extends.description: A base config this one builds on, relative to this file. Session keys set here override the base's; a window with the same name replaces the base's.

session.description: The tmux session and its lifecycle hooks.

aliases.description: Extra names `wyrm <name>` accepts for this project.

env.description: Environment variables for every pane and hook.

hook_timeout.description: Limit for each hook and post_window, as a duration such as "90s" or "5m".

name.description: Session name. Defaults to the root directory's name.

on_project_attach.description: Shell run each time wyrm attaches to the session.

on_project_detach.description: Shell run by tmux when a client detaches.

on_project_exit.description: Shell run before `wyrm kill` destroys the session.

on_project_first_start.description: Shell run before the very first build of this project.

on_project_restart.description: Shell run before every build after the first.

on_project_start.description: Shell run before a fresh build.

project_dir.description: Written by `wyrm migrate-config`: the project directory a shared config belongs to.

root.description: Session directory. Relative paths resolve against this file's directory; ~ and $VAR expand.

startup_pane.description: Pane index to focus in startup_window.

startup_window.description: Window to focus after building, by name or index.

layout.description: tmux layout for the legacy panes list.

panes.description: Deprecated flat pane list; use splits.

post_window.description: Shell run once every pane of the window exists.

pre_window.description: Typed into every pane of the window before its own command.

remain_on_exit.description: Keep panes open after their process exits.

synchronize.description: Turn on synchronize-panes for this window.
